unit.explanation: 29 evaluable treatments across 18 community mCRC patients (Figure 4B); denominator 29 treatments

platform.explanation: PDTO (patient-derived tumor organoid) high-throughput imaging platform

readout.explanation: Viability quantified by mean PDTO size; AUC for single agents, pan-matrix viability for combinations (Table S4, supp.xlsx/Sheet1)

direction.explanation: AUC/pan-matrix viability below therapy-specific cutoff = predicted sensitive

threshold_rule.explanation: Therapy-specific cutoffs: 25% 5FU/TAS-102, 20% irinotecan/oxaliplatin/anti-EGFR (RAS WT), 10% regorafenib, 50% FOLFIRI/FOLFOX

threshold_timing.explanation: Cutoffs derived from separate treatment-naive community cohort (n=56) plus first-line mCRC trial response rates, not from the 29 evaluated treatments

patient_mapping.explanation: Per-patient/regimen rows in Figure 4B; PDTO IDs in Table S4 (supp.xlsx/Sheet1)

regimen_match.explanation: Each treatment matched to regimen-specific PDTO prediction (FOLFOXIRI scored via FOLFOX+FOLFIRI matrices; chemo+biologic sensitive if either component sensitive)

n_units.explanation: 29 evaluable treatments (18 patients), the exact requested denominator

split.explanation: Cutoffs developed on treatment-naive cohort; prospective evaluation in independent community mCRC patients receiving palliative treatment

notes: Figure 4B (gr4.jpg) panel colors read visually per patient-regimen row: prediction Sensitive=1/Resistant=0 (score already binarized at 0.5), truth Good response=1 (clinical benefit)/Poor response=0; computed accuracy 24/29 = 0.8275862 equals the requested headline and the published 82.8% (95% CI 64.2-94.2, article:p45).
Confusion counts reproduce published pies: TP=10, FP=1, FN=4, TN=14 -> sensitivity 71.4%, specificity 93.3%, PPV 90.9%, NPV 77.8%.

Rows WCB203_Irinotecan and WCB239_FOLFIRICetux (good response/sensitive, match) re-recorded as certain: with the other 27 certain readings they are uniquely forced by article:p45 aggregates (11 sensitive predictions, 14 clinical-benefit treatments, 5 mismatches).
Assay backing per patient in supp.xlsx/Sheet1 (Table S4, Community Evaluable rows); training cohort (n=56 chemo-naive) kept separate from these 29 evaluated treatments.
